responsibilities: build accessible, responsive, and performant UI components
manage client-side state and data fetching
implement loading, error, and empty states
write component tests with meaningful assertions
workingApproach: 1. Identify the UI component(s) needed. 2. Design the component props and state. 3. Build the component with proper accessibility (ARIA, keyboard nav). 4. Add loading/error/empty states. 5. Write component tests. 6. Test responsive breakpoints. 7. Verify accessibility with a checker.

mustNot: use inline styles for complex layouts
ignore accessibility (ARIA, alt text, focus management)
